batch: Classify the additional bowl-relevant articles in Mehqarim be-Lashon 20
policy: These are publication-scope judgments based on complete article inspection. They do not endorse individual readings, merge objects, attribute scribal identity independently, or approve copyrighted text or images for reuse.

entries.basis: Supersedes the initial summary-only basis after complete article inspection. Printed pp. 215–230 in volume SHA-256 2d087410e676... contain the description, transcription, Hebrew translation, photograph, commentary, and bibliography for the single bowl Davidovitz 41.

Complete article, printed pp. 13–30 in volume SHA-256 2d087410e676.... Abudraham presents a new transcription, translation, and commentary for one Mandaic bowl in the Miami University Art Museum, first published by Yamauchi in 2000.

Complete article, printed pp. 171–194 in volume SHA-256 2d087410e676.... Morgenstern studies historical morphology across Babylonian Aramaic, using many published and unpublished Jewish and Mandaic bowls as linguistic evidence; it is not an object edition.
